title: A study to test the safety and effects of IOMX-0675, an antibody treatment, alone or with pembrolizumab, in patients with advanced or spreading solid tumors that have already been treated (LIMNOS)
official: A phase I/II trial of IOMX-0675 a fully human monoclonal antibody selectively inhibiting LILRB1/2 alone or in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with previously treated advanced/metastatic solid tumors (LIMNOS)
summary: Main objective: Identify the Recommended Phase II Dose of IOMX-0675 in monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab.
conditions: Miscellaneous and site unspecified neoplasms malignant and unspecified

interventions.name: KEYTRUDA 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years (or legal age of consent in the country) at the time of signing the informed consent form
2. For monotherapy backfill cohorts: histologically confirmed: a) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) treated with a cytotoxic systemic regimen, immune checkpoint inhibitor and/or targeted therapy, or b) gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer treated with a fluoropyrimidine containing systemic regimen, or c) mesothelioma treated with a cytotoxic systemic regimen and/or immune checkpoint inhibitor, or d) kidney cancer (RCC) treated with a targeted (anti-angiogenic) and/or immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
3. For combination cohorts: histologically and molecularly confirmed advanced or metastatic MSS or pMMR colorectal cancer having received one prior line of therapy containing a fluoropyrimidine-containing regimen AND anti-angiogenetic and/or anti-EGFR therapy.
4. Cytologically or pathologically confirmed locally advanced, inoperable, and/or metastatic cancer
5. All subjects must have received at least one previous line of systemic therapy for the tumor type under investigation
6. ECOG Performance Status of 0 or 1
7. For male subjects with female partners of childbearing potential and female subjects of childbearing potential: agreement to use contraception during treatment and for ≥ 3 months after the last dose of IOMX-0675
8. Recovery from all toxicities of previous anti-cancer therapy (including radiotherapy) to Grade ≤ 1 or stable Grade 2 (NCI CTCAE v5), except for alopecia, asymptomatic endocrinopathies, or toxicities managed with stable replacement therapy (e.g., hypothyroidism, adrenal insufficiency)
9. Adequate organ function within 7 days prior to the first IMP administration, as assessed by: a)	ANC ≥ 1200/µL b)	Platelets ≥ 75,000/µL c)	Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL d)	Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5×ULN (or ≤ 3.0×ULN for Gilbert's disease) e)	AST and ALT ≤ 3.0×ULN (≤ 5.0×ULN with hepatic metastases) f)	Albumin WNL g)	eGFR ≥ 50 mL/min (CKD-EPI formula) h)	No transfusions, substitutions, or stimulating factors within 2 weeks prior to blood testing
10. At least one evaluable lesion by iRECIST criteria (backfill cohorts of monotherapy and all combination cohort)
11. Willingness and ability to undergo serial tumor biopsies (baseline and post-baseline) (backfill cohorts of monotherapy and all combination cohort)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Significant uncontrolled cardiovascular disease or NYHA class III or IV cardiac insufficiency
2. History of Grade > 3 immune-related adverse events (irAEs) with prior immunotherapy
3. Unresolved toxicity > Grade 1 from prior therapies (except alopecia and toxicities managed with stable substitution therapy)
4. Clinically relevant findings on screening 12-lead ECG, per investigator judgment
5. Psychological conditions potentially compromising trial compliance, per investigator judgment
6. History of pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease (combination cohorts only)
7. More than four prior lines of systemic therapy (for backfill monotherapy and combination cohorts only)
8. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
9. Known symptomatic CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis a)	Exception: stable, previously treated brain metastases (no progression on MRI for ≥ 4 weeks, no neurologic symptoms at baseline, no steroids for ≥ 7 days prior to study medication) b)	Patients eligible for complete surgical resection of brain metastases are excluded
10. History of significant cerebrovascular disease (e.g., stroke) within 6 months or Grade ≥ 3 sensory/motor neuropathy
11. Treatment with anti-cancer or investigational drugs within 5 half-lives or 30 days prior to first drug administration (whichever is shorter)
12. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
13. Known symptomatic CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis a) Exception: stable, previously treated brain metastases (no progression on MRI for ≥ 4 weeks, no neurologic symptoms at baseline, no steroids for ≥ 7 days prior to study medication) b) Patients eligible for complete surgical resection of brain metastases are excluded
14. Active autoimmune disease or syndrome requiring systemic steroids or immunosuppressants, except for: a) Inhaled corticosteroids b) History of autoimmune disease not requiring systemic treatment for ≥ 2 years (except autoimmune-induced thyroid dysfunction) c) Vitiligo or resolved childhood asthma/atopy d) Local steroid injections e) Hypothyroidism stable on hormone replacement
15. Known or suspected hypersensitivity to IOMX-0675 or its excipients (L-histidine, L-arginine polysorbate 80)
